title: Catalog launch flow — illustrated onboarding & deprecation annotations for release notes
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design and produce a concise set of annotated screenshots and lightweight illustrated assets for the Model Catalog release note and quickstart. This work includes: compact onboarding screenshots that fit within release note column width, deprecation banners with accessible color contrast and alt-states, price-tier microcopy variations (per-token vs per-request), and a short visual guide for the docs team showing which screenshot variants to use in new model announcements vs deprecation notices. Focus on single-column, mobile-constrained widths and clear annotations so PMs can drop images directly into the release note template without re-editing.
acceptance_criteria: One export package (PNG + WebP) with all screenshot variants: new-model (hero + details), deprecation (banner + inline), and pricing-callouts
Figma file with named layers, redlines, and component-based symbols for quick edits
Alt-text and short captions for each image provided in a single CSV for the docs team
Localization-ready copies for en-US, fr-FR, de-DE with character-safe screenshots (no overflow)
Accessibility check: color contrast >= WCAG AA for deprecation banners; keyboard-focus highlight shown in one screenshot
tasks: Design compact hero + details layout for new model card (mobile and desktop widths)
Create three deprecation banner treatments (soft, strong, timeline) and test contrast
Draft pricing microcopy variants and wire into screenshot callouts
Produce annotated redlines and a single-sheet export guide with filenames and usage recommendations
Create localization-safe exports and hand off CSV with alt-text to docs
Upload final assets to Drive and add links to release PR and Confluence
